messages:
michael: Halcyon wants a concise POC to demonstrate sustained 600 qps (per-request) with p95 < 50ms for chat, plus handling 1k qps microbursts for up to 45s. They also need a security Q&A, options for VPC/private control plane, and a pricing comparison (reserved vs on-demand). Can we scope and run?

tara: Yes. Proposed approach: dedicated cluster, redwood-m-8k quantized baseline. Need to confirm exact token envelopes and cacheable prefix.

michael: They said typical user message ~40 tokens, system prefix ~30 tokens (cacheable), response ~120 tokens. History depth 1. They want KV prefix caching enabled.

eli: Quick load plan (wrk-like):
```
precondition: provision 4xA100, NVMe for KV cache, KMS configured
soak: 90m @ 350 qps (warm model + KV)
main-run: 3 repeats of { ramp 0->600 qps over 3m; sustain 10m @600 qps; inject 45s burst @1000 qps at minute 5 }
metrics: p50/p90/p95/p99, success rate, queue depth, tokens/sec, GPU util, batch window distribution
notes: capture perf traces and kernel timings, enable verbose batch logging during one run
```

eli: Infra suggestion: start with 4 A100s, 8 inference workers, batch window 10ms normal, bump to 12ms during bursts, KV TTL 60s. Fallback route to smaller model if sustained overload >1s.

sara: Security checklist items from Halcyon: KMS-backed keys (HSM optional), SOC2 evidence, TLS everywhere, log redaction for PII, retention policy. I'll draft Q&A and attach SOC2 excerpts + network diagram. ETA EOD today.

ops-bot: infra-bot: cluster halcyon-poc-6162 created (4xA100). bench-harness:v3 queued.

eli: Running a short smoke now (5m) to sanity check. Early smoke: sustained 600 qps -> p95 47ms, p50 17ms. 1k qps 30s spike -> p99 ~220ms and a few 502s from queue overflow. Tunables: increase batch window to 12ms during spike, increase KV TTL to 90s if cache hit variance high, tighten retry/backoff to avoid amplifying queue.

tara: Cost note for initial estimate: baseline on-demand compute + token ~ $10/1M output tokens without cache. With prefix KV caching expect 15-25% token reduction; quantization gives compute cost savings. We'll produce reserved (1-month) vs on-demand sheet.

michael: Action items:
1) eli: full soak + 3 main runs with tunings, export dashboards and traces - ETA: tomorrow morning
2) sara: security Q&A draft + SOC2 excerpt + network diagram - ETA: EOD today
3) finance: pricing sensitivity table (no cache / prefix cache / prefix+response cache) and reserved vs on-demand compute - ETA: 48h
4) ops: document runbook with steps to repro and rollback - ETA: with run artifacts

eli: I'll also include a short appendix with recommended runtime config: batch_window=10ms (12ms bursts), kv_ttl=60-90s, conservative fallback model, retry budget=2.

sara: Note: if Halcyon requires HSM-managed KMS we need to signal ~2-3 week lead for integration. Adding to reply.

michael: Good. Once runs are done we'll package perf writeup + shot clock pricing + security packet and send as one bundle. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
